VulkanMod Reforged for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge).

Alpha build. Recent compatibility checks cover specific mod versions, not every modpack.

Install only the production JAR in the matching loader/version. The source JAR and source ZIP are for development. SHA256SUMS.txt lists download checksums.

The source ZIP contains the corresponding source and build scripts for this commit. LGPL-3.0-only; preserve applicable notices and identify modified versions. See LICENSE, COPYING, and NOTICE.

Includes the recent FancyMenu and Gnetum/Ixeris HUD fixes. The prior development tree passed 1,174 automated checks, with one opt-in skip; Gnetum 3.3.2 and Ixeris 4.2.0 were checked at 100% and 50% render scale with caching enabled. This publication rebuild also changes branding and removes ordinary source comments and private tooling. No new FPS claim.
